12.title: Ottawa's $493 billion receipt (2025–26)
12.desc:
Where federal spending went in 2025–26, by type.

📊 The numbers (Public Accounts of Canada 2025–26, Vol. II, gross expenditures by type)
• Total: $493.5B, about $11,860 per person ($32.49 a day)
• Transfer payments to people, provinces and programs: $294.1B (60%)
• Federal employees: $67.3B
• Debt charges: $48.3B
• Consultants and professional services: $22.8B

💬 Which line surprised you?

Per person uses Statistics Canada's population on July 1, 2025 (41.6M). Gross expenditures by standard object; items may not add due to rounding.

13.title: Who got Ottawa's biggest contracts?
13.desc:
The biggest federal contracts ever disclosed, and how Ottawa awards them.

📊 The numbers (Treasury Board proactive disclosure, contracts over $10,000)
• 1,119,203 contracts disclosed, worth $420B in total commitments
• #1: SkyAlyne, $11.2B (National Defence)
• #2: Irving Shipbuilding, $10.8B (National Defence, ships)
• No competition: $62B, about 1 dollar in 7
• Award type not stated: $69B

💬 Should every contract over $1M have to be competed?

Contract value is the total committed over the life of the contract (including amendments and taxes), counted once in the year it was first awarded. Lamps: green = competed, red = non-competitive.

16.title: Edmonton spread out: 1975 to 2020 from space
16.desc:
How much of the land around Edmonton is covered by buildings, mapped from satellite images, 1975 to 2020.

📊 The numbers (EU Joint Research Centre, GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, 100 m grid; a 60 km square centred on downtown)
• 1975: 84 km² covered by buildings
• 2000: 117 km²
• 2020: 166 km², 97% more than 1975 (nearly double)
• Added 2000–2020: 49 km², vs 33 km² in 1975–2000

💬 Which city should we do next?

How to read it: each 100 m square takes the colour of the first satellite snapshot (1975, 1985, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020) in which buildings covered 20% of it. The square-kilometre totals add up the full building area of every square, with no threshold. This is the ground under buildings, not the city limits or the metro area. Years between snapshots are modelled by the JRC; nothing is drawn between snapshots. The opening camera move is the only animation that isn't data.

Source: Pesaresi M., Politis P. (2023), GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, European Commission, Joint Research Centre (CC BY 4.0).
Voice, music and sound: original.
